title: Fail-early host lookup before transaction is the correct atomicity design
description: Building outbox_peers before calling insert_outbound_message means host-lookup failures fire before any INSERT. A future contributor might suggest 'moving the lookup back inside the transaction for cleanliness' — that would re-introduce the bug where a message is committed to the DB with no outbox entries (Pending forever). The two-phase approach (resolve all peers first, then commit atomically) is the correct design: the transaction boundary should enclose only operations that must succeed or roll back together, not I/O that can be checked upfront.
